title: Blackbox HTTP lifecycle
goal: Verify local fixture reports ready; preserve business failures and separate execution progress, performance, evidence and delivery.

sources.title: Independent local fixture requirement
sources.text: The local HTTP fixture at http://127.0.0.1:18882 exposes GET /api/value?value=ready and returns JSON. Requirement BB-READY: the response must be HTTP 200 and JSON status must equal ready. The /api/value?value=wrong probe deliberately returns wrong and must fail the same independent ready requirement. A completed HTTP request does not imply this business requirement passed.
